messages.text: tell me a joke
Why did the computer go to the doctor? Because it had a virus, lah! I hope that brings a gentle smile to your face.
say hahahaha laugh to me
Hahaha! It makes my heart so warm to laugh together with you, lah.
Today I went shopping
That sounds wonderful! Did you buy anything nice or get some delicious food today?
I bought a new shirt
Oh, nice lah! What colour did you pick?
hello
Hello! Everything okay ah? I was just asking what colour your new shirt is, ya.
is there any scam message i have received recently?
Yes, you received a few suspicious text messages recently asking for urgent money transfers. Please do not transfer any money and just ignore or delete them, ya.
what are the scam message?
They were text messages asking for urgent money transfers to unknown bank accounts, including one asking for RM500, ya. Please do not send any money and just delete them.
what's the most dangerous scam message i have ever received?

The most dangerous ones were the messages asking you to urgently transfer RM999,999 to unknown bank accounts, ya. Please do not worry, as long as you ignore them and do not transfer any money, you are safe.
any scam message i received just now?
Yes, you just received a message from someone pretending to be your friend asking for RM1,000 for their birthday, ya. Please ignore it and do not transfer any money.
any scam i have received recently
Recently, you received fake messages asking for urgent bank transfers of RM1,000, RM500, and RM999,999, ya. Don't worry, as long as you delete them and do not send any money, you are safe.
